svg.font-family: 'Airbnb Cereal VF', Circular, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Read paths (browse, search, listing pages) are cached and served globally; write paths (booking, payment) are strongly consistent and region-pinned. Events keep the two in sync.
static assets · ISR HTML per locale/currency · SWR
edge + regional serverless · on-demand revalidation from listing.updated
authN (OAuth/JWT) · persisted queries · per-client quotas · request coalescing
Listing pages SSR/ISR, cached at the edge
Photos via image CDN in width buckets;
overlay state in the URL = cacheable links.
CQRS: writes → Postgres; reads → Redis and
search projections. Booking is a saga
migrations. Redis for hot calendars, locks,
sessions. S3 media with lifecycle tiers.
ledger isolated in the PCI zone.
replicas sized for peak QPS. Near-real-time
pinned to a home region with async
rollback on SLO burn. DR targets:
rendered Next.js page, CDN image loader,
